name: proto-unresolved-import-of-a-file-failing-to-link
description: Under proto.import_paths an import no root resolves fails no file, so a file that holds one and also fails over a duplicate field number carries a schema-unparsed note with protoc's error for that number alone, and publishes nothing. Since a schema file that could not be read may use any declaration, every record of the target is published live, and a schema-findings-withheld note names the target root.
